metadata.title: 90s Hip-Hop Portrait with Grid and Texture Overlays

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast male portrait featuring a dark, moody atmosphere with a geometric grid and text-based skin textures typical of late 90s urban music design.
excludeWhen: bright or pastel color palettes are requested
modern flat vector design is the goal

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up portrait of a man emerging from deep black shadows, characterized by warm yellow-orange highlights. The image is divided by a subtle black grid and features micro-typography mapped onto the skin's highlights. A large, italicized, 3D-extruded title sits at the top, accompanied by a secondary subtitle in a rectangular frame.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm skin tones contrast sharply against the absolute black negative space.
The 3D title at the top anchors the composition and provides a sense of depth.
The grid lines and skin-mapped text create a digital-organic hybrid texture.
The subtitle is aligned to the right, balancing the heavy left-leaning tilt of the main title.
coreInvariants: Chiaroscuro lighting focusing on the forehead, nose, and lips.
A 3x3 or 4x4 grid overlay that subtly shifts the alignment of facial features.
Warm amber and gold color palette for highlights.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and fills the middle two-thirds of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit nose and forehead area serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large 3D title, moves down the bridge of the nose to the lips, and then scans the textured skin details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space surrounds the face, creating a claustrophobic and intense mood.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden amber and warm yellow (skin highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, focusing on monochromatic warmth.
paletteRestrictions: Keep shadows pure black without noise

letterConstructionRules: Thick 3D extrusion with a top-down perspective
Lowercase for the main title to create a continuous block shape
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' and 'l' are merged to create a bridge between words
Extrusion depth is uniform across all characters

composition.relationshipToImage: contained in a thin white stroke box

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, 3D display face paired with a clean, wide-tracked technical sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thin white rectangular frame for subtitle
Subtle black grid lines (approx 1px) over the face

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the display title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man in chiaroscuro lighting (amber highlights, black shadows). Apply a subtle black grid and map a repeating pattern of small text onto the highlighted areas of the skin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, 3D-extruded, italicized lowercase title in light grey at the top. Below it to the right, add a small, wide-spaced subtitle inside a thin white rectangular frame.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?
Is the main title 3D and italicized?
Is there a grid and text texture on the face?
Is the color palette limited to black, amber, and grey?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the micro-text on skin
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
The 'Parental Advisory' label (use a generic placeholder or omit)
Exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of text texture on skin
avoid: Thin, delicate fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Check that the 3D extrusion direction is consistent.
Ensure the grid lines are subtle and do not overpower the face.
Verify that the text on skin follows the contours of the face.
Confirm the background is pure black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Chiaroscuro Portrait + Grid Overlay + Skin Text Mapping + 3D Extruded Sans-Serif Title
